lines.text: Jesus enters a village, and a woman named Martha welcomes Him into her home.
Martha's sister Mary sits at the Lord's feet, listening to His message.
Martha, distracted by preparations, asks Jesus if He does not care that her brother left her to serve alone.
Jesus tells Martha she is worried and upset about many things.
Jesus says only two things are necessary, and Mary has chosen the good portion that will not be taken away.
